config.procedure: nested i.i.d. fields e_eps(x) = V(x) 1[U(x) < eps]; exact all-input check via FFT; first failing eps located on a grid: step 0.04 from 0.20, then step 0.008 in the 0.08 window below, then step 0.002 in the 0.016 window below; reported value is the last passing grid point (realised error rate). Failures between grid points below the located window are not excluded.

second_hom.definition: M = g on a random set of density eps, f elsewhere; f(a,b)=a+b, g(a,b)=a+2b; for eps > 1 - 1/q the realised error rate saturates because g = f on b = 0
